translations.literal: Other officials, whether in office or retired, all received one generation.
translations.idiomatic: All other officials, whether in active service or retired, received posthumous ennoblement for one generation.

sentences.zh: 有兄弟同贈者，贈官加一等，父在止一資，文臣有出身，贈至秘書監，無出身，至光祿卿。

translations.literal: If brothers received ennoblement together, one grade was added; if the father was living, only one grade; civil officials with examination background up to Director of the Secretariat Library, without background up to Chamberlain for Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: When brothers received ennoblement together, one additional grade was granted; if the father was still living, only one grade was allowed. Civil officials with examination credentials could be ennobled up to Director of the Secretariat Library; those without, up to Chamberlain for Attendants.

sentences.zh: 武臣至金吾衛上將軍止。

translations.literal: Military officials up to Senior General of the Gold Bear Guard only.
translations.idiomatic: For military officials, ennoblement went no higher than Senior General of the Gold Bear Guard.

sentences.zh: 凡贈官至三世者，初贈東宮三少，次陳宮三太，次三公，次中書令，次尚書令，次封小國，自小國升次國，自次國升大國，已大國者移國名而已。

translations.literal: For all posthumous offices reaching three generations: first the Eastern Palace Three Juniors, next the Eastern Palace Three Seniors, next the Three Dukes, next Director of the Chancellery, next Director of the Secretariat, next ennoblement as minor state; from minor state promoted to secondary state, from secondary state to great state; if already a great state, only the state name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: For posthumous ennoblement reaching three generations, the sequence was: first the Eastern Palace Three Juniors, then the Eastern Palace Three Seniors, then the Three Dukes, then Director of the Chancellery, then Director of the Secretariat, then ennoblement as a minor state; from minor state one advanced to secondary state, from secondary state to great state; if already a great state, only the state name was changed.

sentences.zh: 〈（亦有不移者。）〉

translations.literal: (There were also cases not transferred.)
translations.idiomatic: (There were also cases in which the state name was not changed.)

sentences.zh: 若父、祖舊官已高者，自從舊官加贈。

translations.literal: If the father or grandfather's former office was already high, ennoblement was added from that former office.
translations.idiomatic: If a father or grandfather had already held a high office, posthumous ennoblement proceeded upward from that former rank.

sentences.zh: 凡追封，不得至王爵。

translations.literal: In all posthumous ennoblement, princely rank could not be reached.
translations.idiomatic: In all posthumous ennoblement, princely rank was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 兩省官及待制、大卿監、諸衛上將軍、觀察使、正任防禦使、遙郡觀察使、景福殿使、客省使，若子見任或父曾任此官，並贈至三公止。

translations.literal: Officials of the two central secretariats, academicians-in-waiting, grand ministers and supervisors, senior generals of the various guards, observation commissioners, regular defense commissioners, observation commissioners of distant commanderies, commissioners of the Hall of Blessings, and reception commissioners—if the son currently held or the father had formerly held these offices—all were ennobled only up to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of the two central secretariats, academicians-in-waiting, grand ministers and supervisors, senior generals of the various guards, observation commissioners, regular defense commissioners, observation commissioners of distant commanderies, commissioners of the Hall of Blessings, and reception commissioners—if a son currently held or a father had formerly held such an office—could be ennobled only up to the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 父子官俱不至者，文臣贈至諸行尚書止，武臣贈至節度使、諸衛上將軍止，即父曾任中書、樞密使、使相、節度使並一品官者，無止限。

translations.literal: If neither father nor son had reached such offices, civil officials were ennobled only up to various Vice Ministers, military officials only up to military governor or senior guard general; but if the father had formerly served as chancellor, Bureau chief, commissioner with nominal premiership, military governor, or first-rank official, there was no limit.
translations.idiomatic: If neither father nor son had held such offices, civil officials could be ennobled only up to Vice Minister, military officials only up to military governor or senior guard general; but if the father had formerly served as chancellor, Bureau chief, commissioner with nominal premiership, military governor, or first-rank official, there was no ceiling.

sentences.zh: 待制已上持服經恩，服闋亦許封贈。

translations.literal: Academicians-in-waiting and above in mourning who received grace upon completion of mourning were also permitted ennoblement.
translations.idiomatic: Academicians-in-waiting and above who were in mourning and received grace upon completing mourning were also permitted ennoblement.

sentences.zh: 尚藥奉御至醫官使曾任文資，許換南班官。

translations.literal: Imperial Medical Attendants to Medical Commissioners who had formerly held civil qualifications were permitted to exchange for southern circuit offices.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Medical Attendants through Medical Commissioners who had formerly held civil qualifications were permitted to exchange their posthumous offices for southern circuit appointments.

sentences.zh: 司天監官贈不得過大卿、監，仍不許換南班官。

translations.literal: Astronomy Bureau officials' posthumous ennoblement could not exceed grand minister or supervisor, and they were still not permitted southern circuit exchange.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumous ennoblement for Astronomy Bureau officials could not exceed grand minister or supervisor, and exchange for southern circuit offices was still forbidden.

sentences.zh: 凡贈至正郎，許以所贈官換朝散大夫階，大卿、監以上許換銀青階，贈至二世者即除朝散大夫階，三世則金紫階。

translations.literal: For all ennobled up to Regular Gentleman, exchange of the conferred office for Gentleman for Dispersing Merit rank was permitted; grand ministers and supervisors and above could exchange for silver-green rank; ennoblement to two generations conferred Gentleman for Dispersing Merit rank, three generations gold-purple rank.
translations.idiomatic: Those ennobled up to Regular Gentleman could exchange the conferred office for the rank of Gentleman for Dispersing Merit; grand ministers and supervisors and above could exchange for silver-green rank; ennoblement to two generations conferred Gentleman for Dispersing Merit rank, and to three generations, gold-purple rank.

sentences.zh: 咸平四年，詔舍人院詳定。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xianping, an edict ordered the Drafting Academy to review in detail.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Xianping, an edict ordered the Drafting Academy to review the regulations in detail.

sentences.zh: 知制誥李宗諤等請：「追贈三世如舊。

translations.literal: Edict Drafter Li Zong'e and others requested: "Posthumous ennoblement of three generations as before.
translations.idiomatic: Edict Drafter Li Zong'e and others requested: "Posthumous ennoblement for three generations should remain as before.

sentences.zh: 其東宮一品以下雖曾任宰相，止從本品。

translations.literal: For Eastern Palace first rank and below, even if formerly chief minister, only from present rank.
translations.idiomatic: For Eastern Palace offices of first rank and below, even if one had formerly served as chief minister, ennoblement was limited to one's present rank.

sentences.zh: 文武群臣功隆位極者，特恩追封王爵亦如舊。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials whose merit was lofty and position supreme—special grace posthumous princely rank as before.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials whose merit was exalted and position supreme could still receive princely rank by special grace, as before.

sentences.zh: 若因子孫封贈，雖任將相，並不許封王，仍須曆品而贈，勿得超越。」

translations.literal: If through descendants' ennoblement, even if holding general or minister rank, princely rank was not permitted; one still had to proceed grade by grade without exceeding."
translations.idiomatic: If ennoblement came through a descendant, even one serving as general or minister could not receive princely rank; ennoblement had to proceed grade by grade without skipping."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 宰相初拜，有即贈三世者。

translations.literal: When chief ministers were first appointed, some immediately received three-generation ennoblement.
translations.idiomatic: When chief ministers were first appointed, some immediately received posthumous ennoblement for three generations.

sentences.zh: 其後簽書樞密以上皆即時贈，他官須經恩，學士及刺史以上，內侍都知、押班皆中書奉行，餘則有司奏請。

translations.literal: Thereafter Commissioners signing for the Bureau of Military Affairs and above all received immediate ennoblement; other offices required grace; academicians and prefects and above, eunuch chiefs and deputy chiefs—all handled by the Secretariat; the rest submitted by the relevant offices.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Commissioners signing for the Bureau of Military Affairs and above all received immediate ennoblement; other offices required an imperial grace. For academicians and prefects and above, and for eunuch chiefs and deputy chiefs, the Secretariat handled the matter; all others were submitted by the relevant offices.

sentences.zh: 唐制，視本官階爵。

translations.literal: Under the Tang system, one looked to one's office, rank, and title.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang system, ennoblement depended on one's office, rank, and title.

sentences.zh: 建隆三年，詔定文武郡臣母妻封號：太皇太后皇太后皇后曾祖母、祖母、母並封國太夫人；

translations.literal: In the third year of Jianlong, an edict fixed honorific titles for the mothers and wives of civil and military officials: Grand Empress Dowager, Empress Dowager, and Empress—great-grandmothers, grandmothers, and mothers all received State Grand Lady;
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jianlong, an edict fixed honorific titles for the mothers and wives of civil and military officials: for the Grand Empress Dowager, Empress Dowager, and Empress, great-grandmothers, grandmothers, and mothers all received the title State Grand Lady;

sentences.zh: 諸妃曾祖母、祖母、母並封郡太夫人，婕妤祖母、母並封郡太君；

translations.literal: For all consorts, great-grandmothers, grandmothers, and mothers all received Commandery Grand Lady; for Ladies of Handsome Fairness, grandmothers and mothers received Commandery Grand Mistress;
translations.idiomatic: for all consorts, great-grandmothers, grandmothers, and mothers received Commandery Grand Lady; for Ladies of Handsome Fairness, grandmothers and mothers received Commandery Grand Mistress;

sentences.zh: 貴人母封縣太君。

translations.literal: For Ladies of Excellent Worth, mothers received County Grand Mistress.
translations.idiomatic: for Ladies of Excellent Worth, mothers received the title County Grand Mistress.

sentences.zh: 宰相、使相、三師、三公、王、侍中、中書令，

translations.literal: Chief ministers, commissioners with nominal premiership, Three Preceptors, Three Dukes, kings, Palace Attendant, Director of the Chancellery,
translations.idiomatic: Chief ministers, commissioners with nominal premiership, the Three Preceptors, the Three Dukes, kings, the Palace Attendant, and the Director of the Chancellery—

sentences.zh: 〈（舊有尚書令。）〉

translations.literal: (Formerly there was also Director of the Secretariat.)
translations.idiomatic: (The Director of the Secretariat was formerly included.)

sentences.zh: 曾祖母、祖母、母封國太夫人；

translations.literal: great-grandmothers, grandmothers, and mothers received State Grand Lady;
translations.idiomatic: great-grandmothers, grandmothers, and mothers received the title State Grand Lady;

sentences.zh: 妻，國夫人。

translations.literal: wives, State Lady.
translations.idiomatic: wives received the title State Lady.

sentences.zh: 樞密使副、知院、同知、參知政事、宣徽節度使，曾祖母、祖母、母封郡太夫人；

translations.literal: Vice Bureau chiefs, Bureau directors, associate directors, Vice Grand Councillors, Commissioners of the Bureau of Palace Attendants, and military governors—great-grandmothers, grandmothers, and mothers received Commandery Grand Lady;
translations.idiomatic: Vice Commissioners of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Bureau directors, associate directors, Vice Grand Councillors, Commissioners of the Bureau of Palace Attendants, and military governors—great-grandmothers, grandmothers, and mothers received Commandery Grand Lady;

sentences.zh: 妻，郡夫人。

translations.literal: wives, Commandery Lady.
translations.idiomatic: wives received the title Commandery Lady.

sentences.zh: 簽書樞密院事曾祖母、祖母、母封郡太君；

translations.literal: Commissioners signing for the Bureau of Military Affairs—great-grandmothers, grandmothers, and mothers received Commandery Grand Mistress;
translations.idiomatic: For Commissioners signing for the Bureau of Military Affairs, great-grandmothers, grandmothers, and mothers received Commandery Grand Mistress;

sentences.zh: 妻，郡君。

translations.literal: wives, Commandery Mistress.
translations.idiomatic: wives received the title Commandery Mistress.

sentences.zh: 同知樞密院以上至樞密使、參知政事再經恩及再除者，曾祖母、祖母、母加國太夫人。

translations.literal: Associate Bureau directors and above through Bureau chief and Vice Grand Councillor who received grace twice or were appointed twice—great-grandmothers, grandmothers, and mothers were raised to State Grand Lady.
translations.idiomatic: Associate Bureau directors and above through Bureau chief and Vice Grand Councillor who received grace twice or were reappointed—great-grandmothers, grandmothers, and mothers were promoted to State Grand Lady.

sentences.zh: 三司使祖母、母封郡太君妻，郡君。

translations.literal: Commissioners of the Three Departments—grandmothers and mothers received Commandery Grand Mistress; wives, Commandery Mistress.
translations.idiomatic: For Commissioners of the Three Departments, grandmothers and mothers received Commandery Grand Mistress; wives received Commandery Mistress.

sentences.zh: 東宮三太、文武二品、御史大夫、六尚書、兩省侍郎、太常卿、留守、節度使、諸衛上將軍、嗣王、郡王、國公、郡公、縣公，母，郡太夫人；

translations.literal: Eastern Palace Three Seniors, civil and military second rank, Censor-in-Chief, Six Vice Ministers, Vice Ministers of the two central secretariats, Chamberlain for Ceremonials, territorial governor, military governor, senior generals of the various guards, heir apparent kings, commandery kings, state dukes, commandery dukes, county dukes—mothers, Commandery Grand Lady;
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Palace Three Seniors, civil and military officials of second rank, the Censor-in-Chief, the Six Vice Ministers, Vice Ministers of the two central secretariats, the Chamberlain for Ceremonials, territorial governors, military governors, senior generals of the various guards, heir apparent kings, commandery kings, state dukes, commandery dukes, and county dukes—mothers received Commandery Grand Lady;

sentences.zh: 妻，郡夫人。

translations.literal: wives, Commandery Lady.
translations.idiomatic: wives received Commandery Lady.

sentences.zh: 常侍、賓客、中丞、左右丞、侍郎、翰林學士至龍圖閣直學士、給事中、諫議大夫、中書舍人、卿、監、祭酒、詹事、諸王傳、大將軍、都督、中都護、副都護、觀察留後、觀察使、防禦使、團練使，並母郡太君；

translations.literal: Palace Attendants, Masters of Writing, Censors-in-Chief, Left and Right Vice Directors, Vice Ministers, Hanlin Academicians through Direct Academicians of the Hall of Dragon Diagrams, Supervising Secretaries, Remonstrance Grandees, Secretariat Drafters, ministers, supervisors, Rectors, Palace Supervisors, tutors to imperial princes, great generals, area commanders, middle protectors, deputy protectors, acting observation commissioners, observation commissioners, defense commissioners, and training commissioners—all mothers, Commandery Grand Mistress;
translations.idiomatic: Palace Attendants, Masters of Writing, Censors-in-Chief, Left and Right Vice Directors, Vice Ministers, Hanlin Academicians through Direct Academicians of the Hall of Dragon Diagrams, Supervising Secretaries, Remonstrance Grandees, Secretariat Drafters, ministers, supervisors, Rectors, Palace Supervisors, tutors to imperial princes, great generals, area commanders, middle protectors, deputy protectors, acting observation commissioners, observation commissioners, defense commissioners, and training commissioners—all received Commandery Grand Mistress for their mothers;

sentences.zh: 妻，郡君。

translations.literal: wives, Commandery Mistress.
translations.idiomatic: wives received Commandery Mistress.

sentences.zh: 庶子、少卿監、司業、郎中、京府少尹、赤縣令、少詹事、諭德、將軍、刺史、下都督、下都護、家令、率更令、仆，母封縣太君；

translations.literal: Subordinate Directors, junior ministers and supervisors, Vice Rectors, Bureau Directors, junior magistrates of the capital prefecture, magistrates of red counties, Junior Palace Supervisors, Preceptors of Virtue, generals, prefects, lower area commanders, lower protectors, Directors of the Household, Directors of the Watch Office, Vice Premiers—mothers received County Grand Mistress;
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate Directors, junior ministers and supervisors, Vice Rectors, Bureau Directors, junior magistrates of the capital prefecture, magistrates of red counties, Junior Palace Supervisors, Preceptors of Virtue, generals, prefects, lower area commanders, lower protectors, Directors of the Household, Directors of the Watch Office, and Vice Premiers—mothers received County Grand Mistress;

sentences.zh: 妻，縣君，其餘升朝官已上遇恩。

translations.literal: wives, County Mistress; all other court-presenting officials and above upon grace.
translations.idiomatic: wives received County Mistress; all other court-presenting officials and above received titles upon imperial grace.

sentences.zh: 並母封縣太君；

translations.literal: all mothers received County Grand Mistress;
translations.idiomatic: all received County Grand Mistress for their mothers;

sentences.zh: 妻，縣君，雜五品官至三任與敘封，官當敘封者不復論階爵。

translations.literal: wives, County Mistress; miscellaneous fifth-rank officials received sequential ennoblement after three terms; those whose offices qualified for ennoblement no longer considered rank and title.
translations.idiomatic: wives received County Mistress; miscellaneous fifth-rank officials received sequential ennoblement after three terms, and those whose offices qualified for ennoblement were no longer judged by rank and title.

sentences.zh: 致仕同見任。

translations.literal: Retired officials same as active.
translations.idiomatic: Retired officials were treated the same as those in active service.

sentences.zh: 亡母及亡祖母當封者並如之。

translations.literal: Deceased mothers and deceased grandmothers eligible for ennoblement were likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Deceased mothers and grandmothers eligible for ennoblement were treated the same.

sentences.zh: 父亡無嫡、繼母，聽封所生母。

translations.literal: If the father was dead and there was no principal or stepmother, ennoblement of the birth mother was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: If the father was deceased and there was no principal or stepmother, the birth mother could be ennobled.

sentences.zh: 伎術官不得敘封。

translations.literal: Technical and artisan officials could not receive sequential ennoblement.
translations.idiomatic: Technical and artisan officials were not eligible for sequential ennoblement.

sentences.zh: 自宰相至簽書樞密院敘封與三世同，他官惟品至者即時擬封，餘皆俟恩乃封。

translations.literal: From chief ministers to Commissioners signing for the Bureau of Military Affairs, sequential ennoblement was the same as three generations; other offices only when rank was reached received immediate proposed ennoblement; the rest all waited for grace.
translations.idiomatic: From chief ministers through Commissioners signing for the Bureau of Military Affairs, sequential ennoblement followed the three-generation rule; other offices received immediate proposed ennoblement only when rank qualified, and all others waited for imperial grace.

sentences.zh: 咸平四年，從舍人院詳定群臣母、妻所封郡縣，依本姓望封。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xianping, following the Drafting Academy's detailed review, the commanderies and counties conferred on officials' mothers and wives followed their original surname and ancestral seat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Xianping, following the Drafting Academy's review, the commanderies and counties in titles conferred on officials' mothers and wives were assigned according to their original surname and ancestral seat.

sentences.zh: 天禧元年，令文武升朝官無嫡母者聽封生母，曾任升朝而致仕，即許敘封。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianxi, civil and military court-presenting officials without principal mothers were permitted to ennoble birth mothers; those who had been court-presenting and retired were permitted sequential ennoblement.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianxi, civil and military court-presenting officials without a principal mother were permitted to ennoble their birth mother; those who had held court-presenting rank and retired were permitted sequential ennoblement.

sentences.zh: 令給諫、舍人母並封郡太君，妻，郡君。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretaries and Remonstrance officials and Secretariat Drafters—mothers all received Commandery Grand Mistress; wives, Commandery Mistress.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretaries, Remonstrance officials, and Secretariat Drafters—mothers received Commandery Grand Mistress; wives received Commandery Mistress.

sentences.zh: 四年，又令翰林學士至龍圖閣直學士如給、舍例。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Hanlin Academicians through Direct Academicians of the Hall of Dragon Diagrams were also ordered to follow the precedent of Supervising Secretaries and Drafters.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Hanlin Academicians through Direct Academicians of the Hall of Dragon Diagrams were also granted the same titles as Supervising Secretaries and Drafters.

sentences.zh: 封贈之典，舊制有三代、二代、一代之等，因其官之高下而次第焉。

translations.literal: The institution of ennoblement had former regulations of three-generation, two-generation, and one-generation grades, proceeding according to the height of office.
translations.idiomatic: The institution of ennoblement had former regulations of three, two, and one generations, graded according to the rank of office.

sentences.zh: 凡初除及每遇大禮封贈三代者，太師、太傅、太保、左右丞相、少師、少傅、少保、樞密使、開府儀同三司、知樞密院事、參知政事、同知樞密院事、樞密副使、簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qiande, Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, retired, Hou Yi came to participate in the suburban sacrifice. sentences.zh: 自今一品致仕官曾帶平章事者，每遇朝會，宜綴中書門下班。」

translations.literal: From now on, first-rank retired officials who had once held the premiership, at each court assembly, should rank with the Secretariat and Chancellery section."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, first-rank retired officials who had once held the premiership should, at each court assembly, rank with the Secretariat and Chancellery section."

sentences.zh: 二年，令藩鎮帶平章事求休致者亦如之。

translations.literal: In the second year, military governors who had held the premiership and sought retirement were likewise [treated thus].
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, military governors who had held the premiership and sought retirement were treated the same way.

translations.idiomatic: During the Tiansheng and Mingdao reigns, retired officials of Assistant Director rank and above had their sons registered to serve as trial Collators of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 三丞已上為太廟齊郎。

translations.idiomatic: Those of third- and second-rank Vice Director and above had their sons registered as Rectifiers of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 無子，聽降等官其嫡孫若弟侄一。

translations.literal: Without sons, one principal grandson or younger brother or nephew was permitted to receive a lowered-grade appointment.
translations.idiomatic: If there were no sons, one principal grandson or one younger brother or nephew was permitted to receive a lowered-grade appointment.

translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jingyou, an edict stated: "Retired officials had formerly all received half salary, yet those who had never held prominent office sometimes could not support themselves—is this how the state treats the aged and nurtures integrity and shame?

sentences.zh: 其大兩省、大卿監、正刺史、閤門使以上致仕者，自今給奉並如分司官例，仍歲時賜羊酒、米麵，令所在長吏常加存問。」

translations.literal: For those of the Two Departments, chief ministers and supervisors, regular prefects, and Gate Commanders and above who retired—from now on salaries follow branch-service officials, with seasonal gifts of mutton, wine, rice, and flour; local magistrates should regularly inquire after them."

sentences.zh: 其後，又許致仕官子孫免選除近官。

translations.literal: Thereafter, retired officials' descendants were also permitted exemption from selection and appointment to nearby posts.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, descendants of retired officials were also permitted exemption from selection and appointment to nearby posts.

sentences.zh: 四年，臣僚有請致仕，未及錄其子孫而遽亡者，命既出，輔臣皆謂法當追收，仁宗憫之，竟官其後。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, when an official petitioned for retirement but died before his descendants were registered, though the order had been issued and chief ministers all held the law required recall, Renzong took pity and still granted posts to his descendants.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, when an official petitioned for retirement but died before his descendants could be registered, though the order had already been issued and chief ministers all held that the law required its recall, Renzong took pity and still granted posts to his descendants.

sentences.zh: 侍御史知雜事司馬池言：「文武官年七十以上不自請致仕者，許御史臺糾劾以聞。」

translations.literal: Supervising Censor and Concurrent Affairs Director Sima Chi stated: "Civil and military officials over seventy who do not themselves petition for retirement—let the Censorate impeach and report."
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Censor and Concurrent Affairs Director Sima Chi stated: "Civil and military officials over seventy who do not themselves petition for retirement should be impeached by the Censorate and reported to the throne."

sentences.zh: 慶曆中，權御史中丞賈昌朝又言：「臣僚年七十而筋力衰者，並優與改官致仕；

translations.literal: In Qingli, Acting Censor-in-Chief Jia Changchao also stated: "Officials who at seventy have declining strength should all be graciously given rank change and retirement;
translations.idiomatic: During Qingli, Acting Censor-in-Chief Jia Changchao also stated: "Officials who at seventy had declining strength should all be graciously given rank change and retirement;

sentences.zh: 雖七十而未衰及別有功狀、朝廷固留任使者，勿拘此令。

translations.literal: those not yet declining at seventy, or with special merit records whom the court deliberately retains in office—do not restrict by this order.
translations.idiomatic: those not yet declining at seventy, or with special merit records whom the court deliberately retained in office, were not restricted by this order.

sentences.zh: 在京若尚書工部侍郎俞獻卿、少府監畢世長、太常少卿李孝若、尚書駕部郎中李士良，在外若給事中盛京、光祿卿王盤、太常少卿張效、尚書兵部郎中張億，皆耄昏不可任事，並請除致仕。」

translations.literal: In the capital such as Vice Minister of Works Yu Xianqing, Director of the Palace Domestic Service Bi Shichang, Vice Director of Grand Ceremonies Li Xiaoruo, Bureau Director of the Chariot Office Li Shiliang; outside the capital such as Supervising Secretary Sheng Jing, Minister of Splendid Happiness Wang Pan, Vice Director of Grand Ceremonies Zhang Xiao, Bureau Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Zhang Yi—all senile and unfit for duty, petitioned for retirement."
translations.idiomatic: In the capital, Vice Minister of Works Yu Xianqing, Director of the Palace Domestic Service Bi Shichang, Vice Director of Grand Ceremonies Li Xiaoruo, and Bureau Director of the Chariot Office Li Shiliang; and outside the capital, Supervising Secretary Sheng Jing, Minister of Splendid Happiness Wang Pan, Vice Director of Grand Ceremonies Zhang Xiao, and Bureau Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Zhang Yi—all senile and unfit for duty—petitioned for retirement."

sentences.zh: 詔：「在京者令中書體量，在外者下諸處曉諭之。」

translations.literal: Edict: "For those in the capital, let the Secretariat assess; for those outside, inform the appropriate local offices."
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "For those in the capital, let the Secretariat assess them; for those outside, instruct the appropriate local offices to inform them."

sentences.zh: 皇祐中，知諫院包拯、吳奎亦言：「願令御史臺監察年七十已上，移文趣其請老不即自陳者，直除致仕。」

translations.literal: In Huangyou, Remonstrance Academy Director Bao Zheng and Wu Kui also stated: "We wish to have the Censorate supervise those over seventy and send documents urging those who do not promptly declare old age to petition—for those who do not immediately declare, directly remove them to retirement."
translations.idiomatic: In Huangyou, Remonstrance Academy Director Bao Zheng and Wu Kui also stated: "We wish to have the Censorate supervise those over seventy and send documents urging those who do not promptly declare old age—for those who do not immediately declare themselves, directly remove them to retirement."

sentences.zh: 朝廷未行。

translations.literal: The court did not implement it.
translations.idiomatic: The court did not implement it.

sentences.zh: 奎復言：「國家謹禮法以維君子，明威罰以禦小人。

translations.literal: Kui again stated: "The state carefully maintains ritual and law to uphold gentlemen, and clearly applies authority and punishment to guard against petty men.
translations.idiomatic: Kui again stated: "The state carefully maintains ritual and law to uphold gentlemen, and clearly applies authority and punishment to guard against petty men.

sentences.zh: 君子所顧者，禮法也；

translations.literal: What gentlemen concern themselves with is ritual and law;
translations.idiomatic: What gentlemen concern themselves with is ritual and law;

sentences.zh: 小人所畏者，威罰也。

translations.literal: what petty men fear is authority and punishment.
translations.idiomatic: what petty men fear is authority and punishment.

sentences.zh: 繇文武二選為士大夫，是皆君子之地也，儻不以禮法待之，則是廢名器而輕爵祿。

translations.literal: From civil and military selection to become scholar-officials—all are the domain of gentlemen; if they are not treated by ritual and law, then titles and stipends are devalued and rank lightly esteemed.
translations.idiomatic: From civil and military selection to become scholar-officials—all are the domain of gentlemen; if they are not treated by ritual and law, then titles and stipends are devalued and rank lightly esteemed.

sentences.zh: 七十致仕，學者所知，而臣下引年自陳，分之常也，人君好賢樂善而留之，仁之至也。

translations.literal: Retirement at seventy is what scholars know; for subordinates to cite age and declare themselves is the proper division; for the ruler to delight in worth and goodness and retain them is benevolence perfected.
translations.idiomatic: Retirement at seventy is what scholars know; for subordinates to cite age and declare themselves is the proper division; for the ruler to delight in worth and goodness and retain them is benevolence perfected.

sentences.zh: 自三代以來，用此以塞貪墨、聳廉隅，近者句希仲、陸軫等，皆以年高特與分司，初欲風動群臣，而在位殊未有引去者，是臣言未效也。

translations.literal: Since the Three Dynasties, this has been used to block greed and corruption and uplift integrity; recently Gou Xizhong, Lu Zhen, and others were all specially given branch-service posts on account of age; initially wishing to move the multitude of officials, yet those in office scarcely any withdrew—my words did not take effect.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Three Dynasties, this has been used to block greed and corruption and uplift integrity; recently Gou Xizhong, Lu Zhen, and others were all specially given branch-service posts on account of age; initially wishing to move the multitude of officials, yet scarcely any in office withdrew—my words had not taken effect.

sentences.zh: 請詳前奏施行。」

translations.literal: Request detailed implementation of the prior memorial."
translations.idiomatic: I request detailed implementation of the prior memorial."

sentences.zh: 於是詔：「少卿監以下年七十不任厘務者，外任令監司、在京委御史臺及所屬以狀聞。

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict: "Vice ministers and supervisors and below over seventy unfit for administrative duties—outside appointments, let circuit and prefectural commissioners report by document; in the capital, let the Censorate and the relevant bureaus report.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon an edict stated: "Vice ministers and supervisors and below over seventy who were unfit for administrative duties—outside appointments, circuit and prefectural commissioners were to report by document; in the capital, the Censorate and the relevant bureaus were to report.

sentences.zh: 嘗任館閣、台諫官及提點刑獄者，令中書裁處。

translations.literal: Those who had served in the Pavilion-Archive, Remonstrance and Censorate offices, or as Judicial Intendants—let the Secretariat adjudicate.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had served in the Pavilion-Archive, Remonstrance and Censorate offices, or as Judicial Intendants were to be adjudicated by the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 待制已上能自引年，則優加恩禮。」

translations.literal: Drafters and above who can themselves cite age should receive gracious added honors."
translations.idiomatic: Drafters and above who could themselves cite age were to receive graciously added honors."

sentences.zh: 然是時言事之人，競欲擊劾大臣，有高年者俱不自安。

translations.literal: Yet at this time those who memorialized all competed to impeach great ministers; the aged all felt insecure.
translations.idiomatic: Yet at this time those who memorialized all competed to impeach great ministers, and the aged all felt insecure.

sentences.zh: 仁宗手詔曰：「老臣，朕之所眷禮也，進退體貌，恩意豈不有異哉！

translations.literal: Renzong personally wrote: "Old ministers are those I cherish and honor—are not their advancement, withdrawal, bearing, and treatment necessarily different!
translations.idiomatic: Renzong personally wrote: "Old ministers are those I cherish and honor—are not their advancement, withdrawal, bearing, and treatment necessarily different!

sentences.zh: 凡嘗預政事之臣，自今毋或遽求引去，台諫官勿以為言。」

translations.literal: All who had once participated in administration—from now on none should hastily seek withdrawal; Remonstrance and Censorate officials should not speak of it."
translations.idiomatic: All who had once participated in administration—from now on none should hastily seek withdrawal; Remonstrance and Censorate officials should not speak of it."

sentences.zh: 其風動勸勵之方又如此。

translations.literal: The methods of moving and encouraging were again such as this.
translations.idiomatic: The methods of moving and encouraging were again such as this.

sentences.zh: 至於因事責降分司，或老病不任官職之事，或居官犯法，或以不治為所部劾奏，衝替而求致仕者，子孫更不推恩，雖或推恩，其除官例皆降等，若耆老舊臣體貌優異，賞或延於子孫，奉或全給半給。

translations.literal: As for those demoted to branch service on account of affairs, or old age and illness unfit for office, or misconduct in office, or impeachment by subordinates for poor governance, removed and seeking retirement—their descendants received no further grace; even when grace was extended, their appointments were all lowered grade; for venerable old ministers with honored bearing, rewards might extend to descendants, and salary might be fully or half granted.
translations.idiomatic: As for those demoted to branch service on account of affairs, or old age and illness unfit for office, or misconduct in office, or impeachment by subordinates for poor governance, removed and seeking retirement—their descendants received no further grace; even when grace was extended, their appointments were all lowered in grade; for venerable old ministers with honored bearing, rewards might extend to descendants, and salary might be fully or half granted.

sentences.zh: 歲時問勞，皆有禮意。

translations.literal: Seasonal inquiry and consolation—all had ritual intent.
translations.idiomatic: Seasonal inquiry and consolation all had ritual intent.

sentences.zh: 人臣非有罪惡，致仕而去，人君遇之如在位時，禮也。

translations.literal: When a subject without guilt or wickedness retires and departs, for the ruler to treat him as when in office is ritual propriety.
translations.idiomatic: When a subject without guilt or wickedness retires and departs, for the ruler to treat him as when in office is ritual propriety.

sentences.zh: 近世致仕並與轉官，蓋以昧利者多，知退者少，欲加優恩，以示勸獎。

translations.literal: In recent times retirement was accompanied by rank transfer—because many were blind to profit and few knew withdrawal, added grace was intended to show encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: In recent times retirement was accompanied by rank transfer—because many were blind to profit and few knew withdrawal, added grace was intended to show encouragement.

sentences.zh: 推行既久，姑從舊制。

translations.literal: Long established, provisionally follow the old system.
translations.idiomatic: Long established, provisionally follow the old system.

sentences.zh: 若兩省正言以上官，三班使臣、大使臣、橫行、正任等，並不除為致仕官。

translations.literal: For officials of Regular Remonstrance rank and above in the Two Departments, third-rank envoys, grand envoys, lateral-rank, and regular commissions—all were not appointed as retired officials.
translations.idiomatic: For officials of Regular Remonstrance rank and above in the Two Departments, third-rank envoys, grand envoys, lateral-rank, and regular commissions—all were not appointed as retired officials.

sentences.zh: 致仕帶職者，皆落職而後優遷其官。

translations.literal: Retired officials who held concurrent posts all lost their posts and then received gracious transfer of rank.
translations.idiomatic: Retired officials who held concurrent posts all lost their posts and then received gracious transfer of rank.

sentences.zh: 看詳別無義理，但致仕恩例不均。

translations.literal: Upon review there was no other principle—only retirement grace was uneven.
translations.idiomatic: Upon review there was no other principle—only retirement grace was uneven.

sentences.zh: 如諫議大夫不可改給事中，並轉工部侍郎，乃是超轉兩資；

translations.literal: Remonstrance Grandee could not be changed to Supervising Secretary, yet both were transferred to Vice Minister of Works—this was skipping two grades;
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance Grandee could not be changed to Supervising Secretary, yet both were transferred to Vice Minister of Works—this was skipping two grades;

sentences.zh: 工部尚書並除太子少保，乃是超轉六資，若知制誥、待制官卑者除卿監，緣知制誥、待制待遇非與卿監比。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Works was all appointed Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent—skipping six grades; if Drafting Academicians and Drafters of lower rank were appointed ministers and supervisors, because Drafting Academicians and Drafters were not comparable to ministers and supervisors in treatment.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of Works was all appointed Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent—skipping six grades; if Drafting Academicians and Drafters of lower rank were appointed ministers and supervisors, it was because Drafting Academicians and Drafters were not comparable to ministers and supervisors in treatment.

sentences.zh: 今他官致仕皆得遷官，此獨因致仕更見退抑。

translations.literal: Now all other officials on retirement received rank transfer—this alone on retirement saw further demotion.
translations.idiomatic: Now all other officials on retirement received rank transfer—this alone on retirement saw further demotion.

sentences.zh: 供奉官、侍禁八品，除率府副率，蓋六品。

translations.literal: Attendant officers and Palace Guard eighth rank were appointed Deputy Director of the Princes' Household—rank six.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant officers and Palace Guard of eighth rank were appointed Deputy Director of the Princes' Household—rank six.

sentences.zh: 諸司副使、承製、崇班七品，除將軍，乃三品。

translations.literal: Deputy Commissioners of various offices, Artisan-in-Attendance, and Honored Court seventh rank were appointed General—rank three.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy Commissioners of various offices, Artisan-in-Attendance, and Honored Court of seventh rank were appointed General—rank three.

sentences.zh: 至於節度使除上將軍，防禦、團練、刺史並除大將軍，緣諸衛名額不一，至有刺史除官高於防禦使者。

translations.literal: As for military governors appointed Senior General, defense, training, and prefectural commissioners all appointed Great General—because guard designations were not uniform, there were cases where prefectural commissioners received appointments higher than defense commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: As for military governors appointed Senior General, and defense, training, and prefectural commissioners all appointed Great General—because guard designations were not uniform, there were cases where prefectural commissioners received appointments higher than defense commissioners.

sentences.zh: 今若令文武官帶職致仕人許仍舊職，上轉一官，及文臣正言、武臣借職以上皆得除為致仕官，則無輕重不等之患。

translations.literal: Now if civil and military officials with concurrent posts who retired were permitted to keep their old posts and advance one rank, and civil Regular Remonstrance and military Provisional Commission and above all could be appointed retired officials, then there would be no inequality of weight.
translations.idiomatic: Now if civil and military officials with concurrent posts who retired were permitted to keep their old posts and advance one rank, and civil Regular Remonstrance and military Provisional Commission and above all could be appointed retired officials, then there would be no inequality of weight.

sentences.zh: 若選人令、錄以上並除朝官，經恩皆得封贈，蔭及四世，旁支例得贖罪、免役。

translations.literal: If selectees of magistrate and recorder rank and above were all appointed court officials, after grace all could receive ennoblement, privilege extending four generations, and collateral lines could redeem crimes and exempt corvée by precedent.
translations.idiomatic: If selectees of magistrate and recorder rank and above were all appointed court officials, after grace all could receive ennoblement, with privilege extending four generations, and collateral lines could redeem crimes and exempt corvée by precedent.

sentences.zh: 又京官致仕亦止遷一官，若光錄寺丞致仕，有出身除秘書省著作佐郎，無出身除大理寺丞，而令、錄職官乃除太子中允或中舍，殊未為當。

translations.literal: Also capital officials on retirement advanced only one rank—if a Director of the Bureau of Splendid Happiness retired, those with examination pedigree were appointed Assistant Compiler of the Secretariat, those without pedigree Assistant Director of the Court of Judicial Review, yet magistrate and recorder officials were appointed Crown Prince Secretary or Crown Prince Attendant-in-Waiting—quite inappropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Also capital officials on retirement advanced only one rank—if a Director of the Bureau of Splendid Happiness retired, those with examination pedigree were appointed Assistant Compiler of the Secretariat, those without pedigree Assistant Director of the Court of Judicial Review, yet magistrate and recorder officials were appointed Crown Prince Secretary or Crown Prince Attendant-in-Waiting—quite inappropriate.

sentences.zh: 若進納出身人例除京官，至有經覃恩遷至升朝官者，類多兼並有力之家，皆免州縣色役及封贈父母。

translations.literal: If purchased pedigree were appointed capital officials by precedent, some reaching court-presenting rank through accumulated grace—mostly powerful families with combined influence—all exempt from prefectural and county labor service and ennobling parents.
translations.idiomatic: If purchased pedigree were appointed capital officials by precedent, some reaching court-presenting rank through accumulated grace—mostly powerful families with combined influence—all were exempt from prefectural and county labor service and ennobling parents.

sentences.zh: 如京官七品，除衙前外，亦名餘色役，尤為僥幸。

translations.literal: Such as seventh-rank capital officials, besides head village service, other labor service was also exempt—especially fortunate.
translations.idiomatic: Such as seventh-rank capital officials, besides head village service, other labor service was also exempt—especially fortunate.

sentences.zh: 條例繁雜，無所適從。

translations.literal: Regulations were complex with no clear guide.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations were complex with no clear guide.

sentences.zh: 如錄事參軍或除衛尉寺丞，或除大理評事，或除奉禮郎恩例不同，可以因緣生弊。

translations.literal: Such as Recorder of Affairs might be appointed Assistant Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, or Assistant Reviewer of the Court of Judicial Review, or Gentleman for Court Rites—different grace precedents could breed abuse through connections.
translations.idiomatic: Such as Recorder of Affairs might be appointed Assistant Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Assistant Reviewer of the Court of Judicial Review, or Gentleman for Court Rites—different grace precedents could breed abuse through connections.

sentences.zh: 今定：凡文臣京朝官以上各轉一官，帶職仍舊不轉官，乞親屬恩澤者依舊條。

translations.literal: Now fixed: all civil capital and court officials and above each transfer one rank; those with concurrent posts keep their posts without rank transfer; those petitioning for relatives' grace follow old provisions.
translations.idiomatic: Now fixed: all civil capital and court officials and above each transfer one rank; those with concurrent posts keep their posts without rank transfer; those petitioning for relatives' grace follow old provisions.

sentences.zh: 選人依本資序轉合入京朝官，進納及流外人判、司、簿、尉除司馬，令、錄除別駕。

translations.literal: Selectees transfer according to their original rank sequence into appropriate capital court office; purchased pedigree and exile outsiders of Administrator, Judicial, Registrar, and Prefect ranks receive Assistant Commandant; magistrates and recorders receive Deputy Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Selectees transfer according to their original rank sequence into appropriate capital court office; purchased pedigree and exile outsiders of Administrator, Judicial, Registrar, and Prefect ranks receive Assistant Commandant; magistrates and recorders receive Deputy Commandant.

sentences.zh: 在京諸司勒留官依簿、尉以上，親賢勞舊合別推恩者取旨。

translations.literal: Capital various offices' detained officials follow registrar and prefect and above; for relatives, worthies, and veterans deserving separate grace—obtain imperial decision.
translations.idiomatic: Capital various offices' detained officials follow registrar and prefect and above; for relatives, worthies, and veterans deserving separate grace, obtain imperial decision.

sentences.zh: 曆任有入已贓，不得乞親戚恩澤，仍不遷官，其致仕官除中書、樞密院外，並在見任官之上，致仕及三年之上，元非因過犯，年未及七十，不曾經敘封及陳乞親戚恩澤，卻願仕宦，並許進狀敘述。

translations.literal: If service records include embezzlement already adjudicated, may not petition for relatives' grace, and still no rank transfer; retired officials except Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs are all above incumbents; retired three years or more, originally not for offenses, age not yet seventy, never previously ennobled or petitioned relatives' grace—if willing to serve again, all permitted to submit memorials for appointment.
translations.idiomatic: If service records include embezzlement already adjudicated, one may not petition for relatives' grace, and still receives no rank transfer; retired officials except the Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs are all above incumbents; those retired three years or more, originally not for offenses, age not yet seventy, never previously ennobled or petitioned relatives' grace—if willing to serve again, all are permitted to submit memorials for appointment.

sentences.zh: 若有薦舉者，各依元資序授官。

translations.literal: If with recommendation, each receive appointment according to original rank sequence.
translations.idiomatic: If with recommendation, each receives appointment according to original rank sequence.

sentences.zh: 其才行為眾所知，朝廷特任使者，不拘此法。

translations.literal: Those whose ability and conduct are known to all and specially appointed by the court—are not bound by this law.
translations.idiomatic: Those whose ability and conduct are known to all and specially appointed by the court are not bound by this law.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 自此宰相以下並帶職致仕。

translations.literal: From this chief councillors and below all retired with concurrent posts.
translations.idiomatic: From this chief councillors and below all retired with concurrent posts.

sentences.zh: 四年，以端明殿學士、尚書右丞王素為工部尚書、端明殿學士致仕，觀文殿學士、兵部尚書歐陽修為太子少師、觀文殿學士致仕。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Bright Hall Academician and Right Vice Director Wang Su was appointed Vice Minister of Works, Bright Hall Academician retired; Viewing Literature Hall Academician and Bureau of Military Affairs Minister Ouyang Xiu was appointed Junior Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, Viewing Literature Hall Academician retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Wang Su, Bright Hall Academician and Right Vice Director, was appointed Vice Minister of Works and Bright Hall Academician in retirement; Ouyang Xiu, Viewing Literature Hall Academician and Minister of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was appointed Junior Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and Viewing Literature Hall Academician in retirement.

sentences.zh: 帶職致仕，自素始也。

translations.literal: Retirement with concurrent posts began with Su.
translations.idiomatic: Retirement with concurrent posts began with Su.

sentences.zh: 五年，守司空兼侍中曾公亮遷守太傅致仕，特許入謝。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Defender of Situ concurrently Palace Attendant Zeng Gongliang was transferred to Defender of Grand Mentor retired, specially permitted to enter court and offer thanks.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, Zeng Gongliang, Defender of Situ concurrently Palace Attendant, was transferred to Defender of Grand Mentor in retirement, specially permitted to enter court and offer thanks.

sentences.zh: 以公亮逮事三朝，既加優禮，仍給見任支賜。

translations.literal: Because Gongliang had served three reigns, added courtesy was granted and present-rank stipends continued.
translations.idiomatic: Because Gongliang had served three reigns, added courtesy was granted and present-rank stipends continued.

sentences.zh: 十月，詔兩省以上致仕官毋得因大禮用子升朝敘封遷官。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, an edict: retired officials of the Two Departments and above may not use sons' court-presenting sequential ennoblement and rank transfer on major ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, an edict stated that retired officials of the Two Departments and above may not use sons' court-presenting sequential ennoblement and rank transfer on major ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 先是，王安石言，李端願、李柬之敘封，中書失檢舊例，法當改正。

translations.literal: Previously, Wang Anshi stated that Li Duanyuan and Li Dongzhi's sequential ennoblement—the Secretariat failed to check old precedent and should be corrected by law.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, Wang Anshi stated that in the sequential ennoblement of Li Duanyuan and Li Dongzhi, the Secretariat had failed to check old precedent and should be corrected by law.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「如此，則獨不被恩。」

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "If so, then alone they receive no grace."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "If so, then alone they receive no grace."

sentences.zh: 安石曰：「敘封初元義理，今既未能遽革，庸可承誤為例？

translations.literal: Anshi said: "Sequential ennoblement originally had no principle; now unable to reform hastily, how can we perpetuate error as precedent?
translations.idiomatic: Anshi said: "Sequential ennoblement originally had no principle; now unable to reform hastily, how can we perpetuate error as precedent?

sentences.zh: 如三師、三公官，因子孫郊恩敘授，尤非宜也。」

translations.literal: Such as Three Preceptors and Three Dukes receiving appointment through sons' suburban grace ennoblement is especially improper."
translations.idiomatic: For Three Preceptors and Three Dukes to receive appointment through sons' suburban grace ennoblement is especially improper."

sentences.zh: 帝從之。

translations.literal: The Emperor assented.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor assented.

sentences.zh: 元豐三年，詔：「自今致仕官遇誕節及大禮，許綴舊班。」

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuanfeng, an edict: "From now, retired officials encountering the Emperor's birthday and major ceremonies are permitted to take their former places in court rank."
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yuanfeng, an edict stated: "From now on, when retired officials attend the Emperor's birthday or major ceremonies, they are permitted to take their former places in court rank."

sentences.zh: 以禮部侍郎範鎮居都城外，遇同天節，乞隨散官班上壽，帝令鎮班見任翰林學士上，故有是詔。

translations.literal: Because Vice Minister of Rites Fan Zhen lived outside the capital, on meeting the Emperor's birthday he requested to offer birthday felicitations with the dispersed-official class; the Emperor ordered Zhen ranked above incumbent Hanlin Academicians—hence this edict.
translations.idiomatic: This was because Fan Zhen, Vice Minister of Rites, lived outside the capital; on the Emperor's birthday he asked to offer felicitations with the dispersed-official class, and the Emperor ordered him ranked above incumbent Hanlin Academicians—hence this edict.

sentences.zh: 又詔：「致仕官朝失儀，勿劾，並著為令。」

translations.literal: Another edict: "Retired officials who breach court decorum in audience shall not be impeached, and this shall be made statute."
translations.idiomatic: Another edict stated: "Retired officials who breach court decorum in audience shall not be impeached, and this shall be made statute."

sentences.zh: 又詔：「自今致仕官領職事者，許帶致仕，該遷轉者轉寄祿官，若止係寄祿官，即以本官致仕。

translations.literal: Another edict: "From now, retired officials holding functional posts are permitted to retire while retaining titles; those eligible for transfer receive transferred stipendiary ranks; if only stipendiary rank, retire at that rank.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict stated: "From now on, retired officials holding functional posts may retire while retaining their titles; those eligible for transfer receive transferred stipendiary ranks, and if holding only a stipendiary rank, they retire at that rank.

sentences.zh: 其見任致仕官，除三師、三公、東宮三師三少外，餘並易之。」

translations.literal: For those holding concurrent retirement posts, except the Three Preceptors, Three Dukes, and the Eastern Palace Three Preceptors and Three Juniors, all others were changed."
translations.idiomatic: For officials holding concurrent retirement posts, except the Three Preceptors, Three Dukes, and the Eastern Palace Three Preceptors and Three Juniors, all others were changed."

sentences.zh: 六年，以守太尉、開府儀同三司、知河南府文彥博為河東、永興節度使、守太師致仕。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Wen Yanbo, Defender of Grand Guardian, Honorary Three Excellencies with Palace Attendance, and Administrator of Henan Prefecture, was made Military Commissioner of Hedong and Yongxing, Defender of Grand Preceptor, retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Wen Yanbo, Defender of Grand Guardian, Honorary Three Excellencies with Palace Attendance, and Administrator of Henan Prefecture, was appointed Military Commissioner of Hedong and Yongxing and Grand Preceptor in retirement.

sentences.zh: 彥博辭兩鎮，止以河東舊鎮貼麻行下。

translations.literal: Yanbo declined the two commands and only the old Hedong command was issued by pasted edict.
translations.idiomatic: Yanbo declined both commands, and only the old Hedong command was issued by pasted edict.

sentences.zh: 彥博又言：「前辭闕下之日，嘗奏得致仕後，當親辭天陛，今既得請，欲赴闕廷。」

translations.literal: Yanbo also stated: "On the day I previously took leave at court, I memorialized that after retirement I should personally bid farewell at the imperial steps; now having obtained permission, I wish to go to the imperial court."
translations.idiomatic: Yanbo also stated: "When I previously took leave at court, I memorialized that after retirement I should personally bid farewell at the imperial steps; now that permission has been granted, I wish to go to the imperial court."

sentences.zh: 降詔從之。

translations.literal: An edict was issued assenting.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was issued assenting.

sentences.zh: 七年，詔文臣中大夫、武臣諸司使以下致仕，更不加恩。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, an edict: civil officials from Regular Grandee and military officials from Commissioners of the Various Bureaus and below who retire receive no further grace.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, an edict stated that civil officials from Regular Grandee and military officials from Commissioners of the Various Bureaus and below who retire receive no further grace.

sentences.zh: 元祐元年，樞密院奏：「諸軍年七十，若以疾假滿百日不堪醫治差使者，諸廂都指揮使除諸衛大將軍致仕，諸軍都指揮使、諸班直都虞候帶遙郡除諸衛將軍致仕，諸班直上四軍除屯衛，拱聖以下除領軍衛，並有功勞者為左，無則為右。」

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanyou, the Bureau of Military Affairs memorialized: "For all armies at age seventy, if on sick leave filling one hundred days they are unfit for medical treatment assignment, commanders of all barracks receive Great Generals of the Various Guards retired; army commanders and chief adjutants of all ranks with distant prefectures receive Generals of the Various Guards retired; ranks above all-ranks privates in the four armies receive Tunwei Guard, and below Gongsheng receive Lingjunwei Guard—with meritorious service on the left, otherwise on the right."
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yuanyou, the Bureau of Military Affairs memorialized: "For all armies, if at age seventy an officer on sick leave for one hundred days is unfit for medical assignment, commanders of all barracks are made Great Generals of the Various Guards in retirement; army commanders and chief adjutants of all ranks with distant prefectures are made Generals of the Various Guards in retirement; ranks above all-ranks privates in the four armies receive Tunwei Guard, and those below Gongsheng receive Lingjunwei Guard—with meritorious service on the left, otherwise on the right."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 四年，詔：」應乞致仕而不原轉官者，受敕後，所屬保明以聞，當與推恩。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, an edict: "Those who petition retirement but do not wish rank transfer—after receiving the edict, their superiors shall certify and report, and grace shall be extended.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, an edict stated: "For those who petition retirement but do not wish rank transfer, after receiving the edict their superiors shall certify and report, and grace shall be extended.

sentences.zh: 中大夫至朝奉郎及諸司使，本宗有服親一人蔭補恩澤。

translations.literal: From Regular Grandee through Court Supporter Gentleman and Commissioners of the Various Bureaus: one kin within mourning obligation of the same clan receives hereditary appointment grace.
translations.idiomatic: From Regular Grandee through Court Supporter Gentleman and Commissioners of the Various Bureaus, one kin within mourning obligation of the same clan receives hereditary appointment grace.

sentences.zh: 橫行、諸司副使見有身自蔭補人，及內殿承製、崇班、閤門祗候見理親民，並承議、奉議郎，許陳乞有服親一人恩例。

translations.literal: Transverse ranks, deputy commissioners with existing self-appointed hereditary beneficiaries, inner-hall commissioners, honored ranks, palace gate attendants managing kin and populace, and Gentlemen for Continuing and Supporting Discussion—all may petition for one kin within mourning obligation.
translations.idiomatic: Transverse ranks, deputy commissioners who already have self-appointed hereditary beneficiaries, inner-hall commissioners, honored ranks, palace gate attendants managing kin and populace, and Gentlemen for Continuing and Supporting Discussion may all petition for one kin within mourning obligation.

sentences.zh: 中大夫、中散大夫、諸司使帶遙郡者，蔭補外準此。

translations.literal: Regular Grandee, Regular Master for Dispersing Merit, and commissioners with distant prefectures: outside appointment follows this.
translations.idiomatic: For Regular Grandee, Regular Master for Dispersing Merit, and commissioners with distant prefectures, outside appointment follows this.

sentences.zh: 即朝奉郎以上及諸司使，雖未授敕而身亡，在外者以乞致仕狀到門下省日，在京以得旨日，亦許陳乞有服親一人恩例。」

translations.literal: For Court Supporter Gentleman and above and Commissioners of the Various Bureaus, even if the edict has not yet been issued and they die—outside the capital from the day the retirement petition reaches the Secretariat, in the capital from the day of imperial assent—they may also petition for one kin within mourning obligation."
translations.idiomatic: For Court Supporter Gentleman and above and Commissioners of the Various Bureaus, even if the edict has not yet been issued when they die—outside the capital from the day the retirement petition reaches the Secretariat, in the capital from the day of imperial assent—they may also petition for one kin within mourning obligation."

sentences.zh: 六年，監察御史徐君平言：「文臣致仕以年七十為斷，而使臣年七十猶與近地監當，至八十乃致仕，願許其致仕之年如文臣法，而給其奉。」

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Supervising Censor Xu Junping stated: "Civil officials retire at age seventy, yet military commissioners at seventy still serve as local supervisors, retiring only at eighty; I ask that their retirement age follow the civil rule and that salary be granted."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Supervising Censor Xu Junping stated: "Civil officials retire at age seventy, yet military commissioners at seventy still serve as local supervisors, retiring only at eighty; I ask that their retirement age follow the civil rule and that salary be granted."

translations.idiomatic: Approved.

translations.idiomatic: The Three Departments stated: "Zhang Fangping was originally Southern Court Commissioner of the Bureau of Palace Attendants, Honorary Grand Tutor, and Junior Preceptor of the Heir Apparent in retirement.

sentences.zh: 元豐官制行，廢宣微使，元祐三年復置，儀品恩數如舊制，方平依舊帶宣微南院使致仕。」

translations.literal: When the Yuanfeng office system was implemented, the Bureau of Palace Attendants was abolished; in the third year of Yuanyou it was restored with ritual rank and grace as under the old system, and Fangping again retired while retaining Southern Court Commissioner of the Bureau of Palace Attendants."

sentences.zh: 紹聖三年詔：「文武官該轉官致仕，依舊出告外，其餘守本官致仕者並降敕，更不給告。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shaosheng, an edict: "Civil and military officials eligible for transferred rank on retirement, aside from the old practice of issuing proclamations, all others retiring at their present rank receive only edicts and no longer receive proclamations.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Shaosheng, an edict stated: "Civil and military officials eligible for transferred rank on retirement, aside from the old practice of issuing proclamations, all others retiring at their present rank receive only edicts and no longer receive proclamations.

sentences.zh: 內因致仕合該乞恩澤人更不具鈔，令尚省通書三司入熟狀，仍不候印畫。」

translations.literal: Those within retirement eligible for grace petitions need no longer submit memorial copies; the Secretariat is to notify the Three Bureaus to enter the completed roster, without awaiting seal and signature."
translations.idiomatic: Those within retirement eligible for grace petitions need no longer submit memorial copies; the Secretariat is to notify the Three Bureaus to enter the completed roster, without awaiting seal and signature."

sentences.zh: 又詔：「應臣僚丁憂中不許陳乞致仕。」

translations.literal: Another edict: "Officials in mourning shall not petition for retirement."
translations.idiomatic: Another edict stated: "Officials in mourning shall not petition for retirement."

sentences.zh: 建炎間，嘗詔：「文武官陳乞致仕，朝廷不從，致有身亡之人，許依條陳乞致仕恩澤，及陳乞致仕而道路不通，不曾被受敕命，亦許州、軍保明推恩。」

translations.literal: During the Jianyan period, an edict was once issued: "When civil and military officials petition retirement and the court does not assent, resulting in death, they are permitted to petition for retirement grace under the regulations; and when retirement is petitioned but roads are impassable and the edict is not received, prefectures and armies may certify and extend grace."
translations.idiomatic: During the Jianyan period, an edict was once issued: "When civil and military officials petition retirement and the court does not assent, resulting in death, they are permitted to petition for retirement grace under the regulations; and when retirement is petitioned but roads are impassable and the edict is not received, prefectures and armies may certify and extend grace."

sentences.zh: 時強行父博學清修，不緣事故疾病，慨然請老，葉份言之，許令再仕。

translations.literal: At the time, Qiang Xingfu was learned and upright, not citing accident or illness, and resolutely requested old age; Ye Fen spoke on his behalf, and he was permitted to take office again.
translations.idiomatic: At the time, Qiang Xingfu was learned and upright, not citing accident or illness, and resolutely requested old age; Ye Fen spoke on his behalf, and he was permitted to take office again.

sentences.zh: 凡類此者，蓋因其材而挽留之也。

translations.literal: For all such cases, it was because their talent was retained.
translations.idiomatic: In all such cases, the court retained them because of their talent.

sentences.zh: 直秘閣致仕鄭南掛冠已久，年德俱高，大臣言之，詔除秘閣修撰，仍舊致仕。

translations.literal: Zheng Nan, Direct Attendant of the Secretariat Pavilion in retirement, had long doffed his cap; in years and virtue both advanced, the ministers spoke, and an edict appointed him Compiler of the Secretariat Pavilion while still in retirement.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Nan, Direct Attendant of the Secretariat Pavilion in retirement, had long doffed his cap; advanced in years and virtue, the ministers spoke on his behalf, and an edict appointed him Compiler of the Secretariat Pavilion while still in retirement.

sentences.zh: 優其恩不奪其志也。

translations.literal: His grace was enhanced without overturning his resolve.
translations.idiomatic: His grace was enhanced without overturning his resolve.

sentences.zh: 呂頤浩以少保乞除一寄祿官致仕，詔除少傅，依前鎮南軍節度使、成國公致仕；

translations.literal: Lü Yihao, as Junior Guardian, petitioned to be made a stipendiary official in retirement; an edict appointed him Junior Mentor, continuing as Military Commissioner of Zhennan Army and Duke of Chengguo in retirement;

translations.literal: Han Shizhong, as Grand Tutor, Military Commissioner of Zhennan-Wu'an-Ningguo Armies and Commissioner of the Liquan Abbey, Duke of Xian'an, petitioned to resign; an edict appointed him Grand Preceptor in retirement.
translations.idiomatic: Han Shizhong, as Grand Tutor, Military Commissioner of Zhennan-Wu'an-Ningguo Armies and Commissioner of the Liquan Abbey, Duke of Xian'an, petitioned to resign; an edict appointed him Grand Preceptor in retirement.

sentences.zh: 因將相之知止而優其歸也。

translations.literal: Because generals and ministers knew when to stop, their return was favored.
translations.idiomatic: Because generals and ministers knew when to stop, their return was favored.

sentences.zh: 楊惟忠、刑煥皆以節度致仕。

translations.literal: Yang Weizhong and Xing Huan both retired as military commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Weizhong and Xing Huan both retired as military commissioners.

sentences.zh: 臣僚言：「祖宗時，節將、臣僚得謝，不以文武，並納節除一官。」

translations.literal: Officials stated: "Under the ancestors, when frontier generals and officials took leave, regardless of civil or military, all surrendered their commissions and received one office."
translations.idiomatic: Officials stated: "Under the ancestors, when frontier generals and officials took leave, regardless of civil or military, all surrendered their commissions and received one office."

sentences.zh: 以今日不復納節換官為非。

translations.literal: They regarded the present failure to surrender commissions for exchanged offices as wrong.
translations.idiomatic: They regarded the present failure to surrender commissions for exchanged offices as wrong.

sentences.zh: 詔今後依祖宗典故，蓋不以私恩勝公法也。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that hereafter the ancestral precedents be followed—so that private grace would not prevail over public law.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that hereafter the ancestral precedents be followed—so that private grace would not prevail over public law.

sentences.zh: 昭慶軍節度使、開府儀同三司、充萬壽觀使韋淵乞守本官致仕，詔免赴朝參，仍依兩府例，合破請給人從。

translations.literal: Wei Yuan, Military Commissioner of Zhaqing Army, Honorary Three Excellencies with Palace Attendance, and Commissioner of the Wanshou Abbey, petitioned to retire at his present rank; an edict exempted him from court attendance and, following the Two Departments precedent, granted full salary and attendants.

sentences.zh: 優親之恩而異之也。

translations.literal: Favored kin received grace and was treated differently.
translations.idiomatic: Favored kin received grace and was treated differently.

sentences.zh: 隆興以後，因臣僚言年七十不陳乞致仕者，除合得致仕或遺表恩澤外，並不許遇郊奏薦。

translations.literal: After Longxing, because officials stated that those seventy and above who did not petition retirement, aside from grace due on retirement or testamentary memorial, were not permitted suburban recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: After Longxing, because officials stated that those seventy and above who did not petition retirement, aside from grace due on retirement or testamentary memorial, were not permitted suburban recommendation.

sentences.zh: 已而復詔：郊祀在近，未致仕人更許陳乞奏薦一次。

translations.literal: Soon an edict was restored: with the suburban sacrifice near, those not yet retired were again permitted one petition for recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: Soon an edict was restored: with the suburban sacrifice near, those not yet retired were again permitted one petition for recommendation.

sentences.zh: 可以不予而予之，示厚恩也。

translations.literal: What need not be granted was granted—showing thick grace.
translations.idiomatic: What need not be granted was granted—showing thick grace.

sentences.zh: 執政在謫籍者陳乞致仕，雖許敘復而寢罷合得恩澤，隻據見存階官蔭補。

translations.idiomatic: Chief councillors on the demotion register who petitioned retirement, though restoration was permitted, the grace due was suspended; only existing rank hereditary appointment applied.

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Chunxi, Wang Youzhi, Commissioner for Propagation of Grace of Ningwu Army and Commissioner of the Youshen Abbey, again received Military Commissioner of Fengguo Army in retirement; officials debated, and he still retired at his present functional rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Chunxi, Wang Youzhi, Commissioner for Propagation of Grace of Ningwu Army and Commissioner of the Youshen Abbey, again received Military Commissioner of Fengguo Army in retirement; officials debated, and he still retired at his present functional rank.

sentences.zh: 可以予而不予，嚴公法也。

translations.literal: What could be granted was not granted—strict public law.
translations.idiomatic: What could be granted was not granted—strict public law.

sentences.zh: 抑揚輕重間，可以見優老恤賢之意，可以識製情抑幸之術，故備錄於篇。

translations.literal: Between restraint and favor, one may see the intent to honor the aged and pity the worthy, and recognize the art of regulating sentiment and restraining favor—therefore it is fully recorded in this chapter.
